producer.title: Our Story
producer.name: Yuko Isobe
producer.intro: At Miso Kobo no Sato in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi, our shop owner Yuko Isobe continues her craft of miso-making.
producer.soybeanSectionTitle: Blue Soybeans from the Foot of Mt. Fuji
producer.soybeanBody1: The soybeans are grown exclusively by contracted farmers in Fujiyoshida at the foot of Mt. Fuji.
producer.soybeanBody2: Low in oil and high in natural sugars, giving the miso its pronounced sweetness.
producer.farmerCaption: A contracted farmer (at the foot of Mt. Fuji)
producer.craftBody1: No heat treatment or alcohol is used to stop fermentation.
producer.craftBody2: A traditional method using the simmered liquid from the earthen kettle (jigama) in the brewing.
producer.craftBody3: A 'living miso' whose fermentation is never halted. Aging time varies by product (see each product page).
producer.certIntro: Miso Kobo no Sato holds the Yamanashi Food Diversity Certification issued by Yamanashi Prefecture. The certified product appendix is shown below as-is.
producer.certMuslimAlt: Yamanashi Food Diversity Certification, Muslim Friendly Star appendix (certified product list)
producer.certVeganAlt: Yamanashi Food Diversity Certification, Vegan Friendly appendix (certified product list)
producer.certNote: Muslim Friendly applies to the same products as above: Koshu Miso and Rice Miso.
